verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents an 'API and MCP' area with scoped service keys meant for 'scripts to interact with your Oneleet workspace', plus an official MCP server. That is a first-party programmatic interface a developer could use for custom integrations. However, nothing shows that this interface can push evidence or test results into controls, and all probed OpenAPI/Swagger spec paths returned 404. Missing for 10: documented API reference/spec, explicit endpoints for uploading evidence or test results to controls, examples of custom integrations for uncovered systems, independent or hands-on corroboration.
